title: CALL payload v1.0
description: One synthetic call attempt reported at its end, including failed attempts.

callId.description: Synthetic call business identity; distinct from the technical eventId.

direction.description: Direction relative to the envelope subscriber.

destinationCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the called endpoint; not inferred from a phone number.

durationSeconds.description: Connected talk time in whole seconds; FAILED has zero talk time.

outcome.description: Normal completion, unexpected disconnect after connection, or failure to connect.

roaming.description: Whether the subscriber uses a visited network; independent of destination country.

networkNodeId.description: Synthetic serving node at the end of the attempt.

towerId.description: Optional synthetic serving tower at the end of the attempt.
